judgments.reasoning_cat1: A single address; nothing to construe.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It matches the Section 12 notice address and the Section 3.1(o) landlord waiver location; consistent.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: The identification numbers are illegible in the executed copy, so the schedule does not in fact identify what Section 5.7(c) says it identifies.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Section 7.5 forbids changing those numbers, a covenant that is hard to police against an unreadable schedule.
Consistent with Section 5.7(d) and Section 4.4(b)'s mechanism for later-acquired claims.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A narrative schedule rather than a list; it uses its own defined terms ("Interest", "Units", "Company Operating Agreement") that do not match the Agreement's "Investor Membership Interest" and "Stock".
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It discloses ongoing member redemption rights and 50 pending redemption requests, which bear directly on Section 7.10's Restricted Payments prohibition, Section 8.9(x)'s default on capital obligations to members, and the Permitted Reorganization definition.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A factual narrative of two matters; the second is described as "about to" be initiated, which is imprecise.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Section 5.10 excepts scheduled matters and actions to enforce Account Debtor obligations, so the disclosure is consistent with the representation.

Section 5.16 represents ownership of the IP "necessary to the conduct of its business" and Sections 4.4(c) and 9.1(i) build machinery around patents, copyrights and trademarks — machinery with nothing to operate on.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: The entries are abbreviated and partly illegible, and the account descriptions ("Lock Box - Cash Management Account") are not the Agreement's defined terms.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: All listed accounts are at Greater Bay Bank, while Section 2.6(a) requires Wells Fargo to be the only Cash Management Bank from 60 days after the Closing Date and Section 6.12(d) restricts maintaining other depository accounts.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: Short and specific, cross-referring to Schedule 5.8 for detail.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Section 7.1(b) permits "Indebtedness set forth on Schedule 5.20", and the single item listed matches Schedule P-1's first Permitted Lien; consistent.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: The list is run together in the executed copy so that company names are broken across entries, making it uncertain how many companies are approved and which.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: Section 5.21 represents that none listed is an Affiliate of Borrower and the Approved Title Insurance Company definition lets Lender add or remove names in writing, so the list is intended to change; consistent.
